description: List media files (images and files) in the workspace, newest first. Paginated: while hasMore is true, pass nextCursor back as cursor while it is set; if hasMore is true but nextCursor is null, page with the offset instead, and past offset 10000 narrow the filter.

cursor.description: nextCursor from the previous page. The page continues after it in the same filter and sort; leave the skip/offset at 0 when you pass it

offset.description: How many rows to skip, at most 10000; page past that with cursor

name: list_media
title: List media
